task: Compute the sum of the first 4 prime numbers (2, 3, 5, 7) and store it via (rlm-set answer ...) then (rlm-set Final true).
lesson: Today I learned (set! answer ...) is invisible because the world key expects (rlm-set answer <value>).

nodes.code: (let* ((primes (filter (lambda (n) (and (not (even? n)) (not (= n 1))) (lambda (i) (if (<= i 2) (if (= n 2) #t (if (even? n) #f (let ((d 3)) (while (< (* d d) n) (if (= 0 (mod n d)) (set! d (+ d 2))) (if (>= (* d d) n) #t #f)))) 1)) (list 2 3 5 7)))) (sum (reduce + 0 primes)) (rlm-set answer sum) (rlm-set Final t))
